issue_1_empty_hex_bounding_boxes.observed_phenomenon: Bounding boxes appear on empty hexes with no units
issue_1_empty_hex_bounding_boxes.root_cause_a: overlay_verification_eda87ad9_300s_360s.mp4 was pre-rendered by output/video_analysis/render_overlay_video.py where board_recognizer.py used min_confidence=0.52 template matching, producing false-positive detections on arena floor textures. These boxes were burned directly into video pixels.
issue_1_empty_hex_bounding_boxes.root_cause_b: src/tft/vision/overlay_renderer.py has static ROI_COORDS['board'] bounding box (280, 180, 720, 320) which draws a large bounding box over the entire board area when ROI debug is enabled.

issue_2_shop_recognition_discrepancy.observed_phenomenon: Shop recognition results look questionable or different from expected champions
issue_2_shop_recognition_discrepancy.root_cause: ShopRecognizerV2 has min_confidence_threshold=0.10, so very low template scores (0.15~0.25) on small splash crops get labeled as RECOGNIZED instead of LOW_CONFIDENCE/UNKNOWN. Furthermore, OCR on 720p Korean font produces garbled text strings which fuzzy matcher picks up.

issue_3_hardcoded_board_bench_fallback.observed_phenomenon: Decision Engine always receives Miss Fortune 2* on Board and Miss Fortune 1* on Bench
issue_3_hardcoded_board_bench_fallback.root_cause: In src/tft/decision/analysis_manager.py line 107-108, board_units and bench_units are hardcoded placeholders because BoardRecognizer was not piped into DecisionAnalysisManager.
